English: Hilltop Perch
A basic earthwork mound and tent atop a prominent hill, offering primitive lookout for approaching threats and quick communication.
Wooden Lookout
A raised wooden platform with a crude shelter, granting improved visibility and warning against raiders and wildlife.
Stone Watch Stand
A sturdy stone platform and low wall giving better defense and a commanding view, manned by trusted scouts.
Beacon Tower
A tall, stone-and-wood tower with fire signal system, enabling swift alerts across the steppe and bolstering clan unity.
Guarded Shelter
A fortified enclosure at the watchtowers base, providing supplies and refuge to scouts and messengers.
Signal Pavilion
A covered signal structure with advanced banners, torches, and bells for coordinated warning and horde mobilization.
Defended Post
A walled compound with barracks for sentries, offering a permanent presence and rapid response to threats.
Messengers Hall
A grand hall for messengers and scouts to rest, resupply, and coordinate vital intelligence, improving horde cohesion and logistics.
High Watch Tower
A monumental stone tower with multiple defensive levels, advanced signal systems, and permanent garrison—projecting power and security over the land.
Iberian Sentinel
An imposing, multi-towered fortress and nerve center for all steppe communications and defenses, inspiring awe and unity among the clans.
